preferences.text: Use “Motivating Reset” as the supplied strategic essence, not as an assumed tagline or proof of product efficacy; the official article announces “Designed to De-Stress” as the newer philosophy.
As an exploratory direction, build calm through usable domestic space, legible circulation, tactile surfaces and natural light; references are inspiration, not approved sets or specifications.

Explore believable everyday actions—such as reading, conversation, settling or getting ready to rejoin the day—rather than relying only on posed rest. These are creative proposals, not proof of an outcome.

The draft proposes warm neutrals with selective colour depth and restrained red identification. Treat these as exploratory relationships only; no authoritative colour values or approved environmental red rule are established.

Adapt setting and lighting to the selected category and exact product appearance rather than imposing one room palette across the portfolio; archived site imagery is dated practice, not a permanent rule.

preserve: Keep the brand’s supplied strategic essence and announced philosophy distinct from product-efficacy claims.
Preserve authentic branding and the exact selected product’s appearance; do not treat inspirational interiors as verified product assets.
The supplied Visual World Guide is draft material, not approved guidance; its examples, labels, and scorecard do not establish mandatory rules.
Retain uncertainty around identity masters and portfolio architecture until confirmed.
explore: Develop a usable, contemporary domestic setting with clear spatial logic and room for both pause and participation.
Test category-specific light, materials, and colour around the actual SKU without recolouring it.
Consider natural human actions and connected home activities as creative options, not claims of product-caused transformation.
avoid: Do not present draft visual suggestions as approved brand rules.
Do not infer exact fonts, colour values, logo lockups, product details, or claims from reference imagery.
Avoid implying medical, stress-treatment, recovery, or quantified product benefits without current product-specific approved evidence.
Do not copy another brand’s identity or transplant a reference scene wholesale.
unknowns: Final production logo and tagline masters, typography, and approved colour specifications.
Whether the proposed portfolio architecture has been adopted.
Selected SKU, variant, product dimensions, mechanism requirements, and approved claims for any future execution.
Whether reference imagery may be reused in production; supplied references are inspiration, not automatic usage permission.
guide.decisionSummary: Use Duroflex’s sourced positioning as context, while keeping visual direction exploratory: the supplied visual guide is explicitly draft, and observed website patterns are preferences rather than requirements. No mandatory visual execution rules are established here.
